plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Information Technology Associate A.S. Degree - CalGETC' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8002/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 66-67; lower bound 66 encoded = 17+18+15+16 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 STAT C1000E/MATH 341/MATH 400 -> 4). CISS 310 pre-req per map: ACCT 101 or 301 (neither sequenced in the map); encoded as one_of with both carried under external_prereqs. CISS 310 advisory: CISC 302 or 310. CISN 304 pre-req per map: CISC 310 (differs from the Cybersecurity maps where CISN 304 carries co-req CISC 323 & 356). Semester 1 math choice: STAT C1000E Introduction to Statistics (4 units; Intermediate Algebra or equivalent), MATH 341 Calculus for Business and Economics (4 units; Intermediate Algebra or equivalent), or MATH 400 Calculus I (5 units; MATH 375 or MATH 372 AND Math 373); lower bound 4 encoded. CISC 360 footnote: or CompTIA A+ certification. Map notes this also meets the requirement for the Certificate of Achievement in CIS-Information Technology (no separate sequence published). Advisories (recommended, not required, per map legend): CISC 310 advisory familiar with basic functions of word process, spreadsheet, web browser software applications; CISC 360 advisory CISC 302 and 310; CISN 300 advisory CISC 310; CISN 301 advisory CISC 323.
